q: In the Baire category sense, the generic ergodic MPT (in the weak topology on Aut(X,μ)) is:
opts: Weakly mixing but NOT strongly mixing
exp: Halmos–Rokhlin theorem: weakly mixing transformations form a dense Gδ (hence comeager); strongly mixing transformations are meager. Positive entropy systems are also meager. The 'typical' ergodic transformation is weakly mixing with zero entropy — very different from the examples that arise naturally.
